Hi there. Thanks for checking out our new product, SUNNNY. The idea is simple: as a B2B company, you store valuable customer information across many systems, making it hard to get an overview. SUNNNY consolidates your data, cleans it, resolves identities, identifies relationships, and presents it neatly for you, your team, and your AI model.

A live product is the best way to understand it, so we invite you to explore SUNNNY with dummy data. Currently, we handhold prospective customers who want to try it live. Email us at HeyShun@sunnny.com with details about your customer data systems, and our product mgt leader Shun Chen will contact you.

We plan a wider release before the end of the year and will share more then. Key points: your data remains strictly yours—we don’t read, train on, or share it. You can manage your encryption keys. We have standard connectors for popular CRM systems and a universal connector for any data. We’re developing skills and instructions for AI models to connect seamlessly to any system and populate SUNNNY.

Enjoy!

Mikkel & Mike

Have a treat
(on desktop)

A live product is the best way to understand it, so we invite you to jump over to your desktop device to take SUNNNY for a spin.

Currently, we handhold prospective customers who want to try it live. Email us at HeyShun@sunnny.com with details about your customer data systems, and our product mgt leader Shun Chen will contact you.

We are hiring

We’re a small, mostly remote team centered in the San Francisco Bay Area. If you value software engineering skills and lean domain-aware applications, send your resume to hiring@sunnny.com. We’ll get back to you.
